index.about.title: About Bada Bhaktmaal Ashram
index.about.intro: Bada Bhaktmaal Ashram is a revered Vaishnav spiritual center in the sacred city of Ayodhya, dedicated to Shri Ram Bhakti, Seva, and the preservation of Sanatan Dharma. Rooted in the Bhaktamal tradition and Ramanandi lineage, the Ashram serves as a place of devotion, discipline, and divine learning.
index.about.feature1.title: Traditional Roots
index.about.feature1.desc: Rooted in the sacred Ramanandi Sampradaya, inspired by the Bhaktamal tradition of Shri Ram devotion
index.about.feature2.title: Spiritual Center
index.about.feature2.desc: A center for Bhakti, Satsang, and spiritual learning under divine guidance of Maharaj ji
index.about.feature3.title: Sacred Location
index.about.feature3.desc: Located just 900 meters from Shri Ram Mandir main gate in the holy city of Ayodhya and 800 meters from Hanuman Gadhi Temple
index.guruji.name: Mahanth Swami Shri Avdheshkumar Das Ji Maharaj
index.guruji.desc: A revered spiritual leader of the Ramanandi tradition, guiding devotees through Shri Ram Katha, Bhakti, and selfless Seva. Under his divine guidance, Bada Bhaktmaal Ashram continues the legacy of Bhaktamal parampara through Katha, Satsang, and Seva.

index.history.title: Our History
index.history.timeline1.title: Traditional Roots – Ramanandi Lineage
index.history.timeline1.desc: The spiritual foundation rooted in the sacred Ramanandi Sampradaya, inspired by the Bhaktamal tradition
index.history.timeline2.title: 19th Century – Establishment in Ayodhya
index.history.timeline2.desc: Established in the holy city of Ayodhya as a center of bhakti, spiritual learning, and saintly tradition
index.history.timeline3.title: 1950s–1980s – Expansion of Katha & Religious Activities
index.history.timeline3.desc: Became a center for organizing Shri Ram Katha, Yagya ceremonies, and major Vaishnav religious gatherings
index.history.timeline4.title: 1990s – Growth of Annadan & Seva Traditions
index.history.timeline4.desc: Large-scale Annadan Seva, Gau Seva, and festival celebrations were expanded

index.history.timeline5.desc: Service camps during Kumbh Mela, extending the Ashram's presence nationwide
